# Caelestinus
Formerly a colony of [color=cyan]TSF contractors[/color] sent to assist the [color=cyan]Trans-Solarian Federation[/color] in introducing its civilians into the Colossus Sector, [color=#279659]Caelestinus[/color] (also known to some as "ColSec" or Colonial Security) went on strike after witnessing the at best apathetic behaviour displayed by some members of the [color=cyan]TSFMC[/color] in the midst of their bloody war against the at-the-time brazen and well-armed [color=tan]Phaethon Dynasty Vanguard[/color]. With the only forces they could get inside of Colossus having their hands full, the [color=cyan]TSF[/color] reluctantly accepted their demands to become an independent group.
[color=#279659]Caelestinus[/color] currently consists of two groups: Caelestinus Security, consisting of [color=#ff4242]Judges[/color] and led by the [color=navy]Overseer[/color], and Medical Dispatch, consisting of [color=#57b8f0]Emergency Responders[/color] and led by the [color=cornflowerblue]Director of Care[/color]. As a group, [color=#279659]Caelestinus[/color] has three primary objectives on which they refuse to compromise on:
> [bold][color=red]Protect and aid the civilian population of the Colossus sector.[/color][/bold]
> [bold][color=red]Bring down any threats to the well-being of the sector's inhabitants.[/color][/bold]
> [bold][color=red]Maintain your independence from the Trans-Solarian Federation.[/color][/bold]
[color=#279659]Caelestinus[/color] control the civilian population centre in the center of the Colossus Sector known as [color=#279659]Caelestinus Central[/color], working to keep it safe from any belligerents who may wish to endanger its inhabitants for whatever reason.
